title:
Epic that opens `Reliability.EditWorkOrderModal` or `Reliability.EditWorkOrderRestrictedModal` based on
work order status.

This epic is triggered by the ROW_ACTION_CLICK_EDIT action from a grid component and uses its default payload.
The payload should include an object representing the selected row, which should contain a `status` property.

- If `status` is 'completed', 'closed', or 'cancelled', the `Reliability.EditWorkOrderRestrictedModal` will
inform the user that editing is not allowed.
- Otherwise, the `Reliability.EditWorkOrderModal` will be displayed and the user can edit the work order.
name: EditWorkOrderModalEpic
